title: Implement email factory
description: Implement the email factory that returns the correct email service implementation based on the EMAIL_MODE setting. Centralizes the mock/live decision.
acceptanceCriteria: Factory reads EMAIL_MODE from the settings table
Factory reads RESEND_API_KEY from settings when mode=live
Throws if mode=live and RESEND_API_KEY is not set
Verify by calling getService() in both modes

steps.details: Export async function `getEmailService(): Promise<EmailService>`. Load settings from repository. Read `email_mode` setting (default 'mock'). If 'mock': return new MockEmailService(). If 'live': read resend_api_key. If not set, throw Error('RESEND_API_KEY not configured in settings'). Return new ResendEmailService(resendApiKey).
Call getEmailService() in mock mode. Verify returns MockEmailService. Set email_mode to 'live' in settings. Verify it throws if no API key, or returns ResendEmailService if key is present.
